event.description:
Join the Grand Archive Regionals at Outpost Ghent! The highest level event in Belgium will allow participants to battle it out for some amazing prizes, including a Nationals Invite!

You can reserve your spot by filling out the following form, but you're free to also pop by without a registration:
https://forms.gle/otEgCeCew4rvhdmQ6

Doors: 10:00
start: 11:00
entry: 35€

Format:
- Best 2 out of 3
- 60 minutes/round
- 5 minutes overtime (3 turns)

Number of rounds (swiss only and NO top cut):
9 - 16 players: 4 rounds
17 - 32 players: 5 rounds
33 - 50 players: 6 rounds

Participation Prizes:
- 1 pack of Grand Archive Dragon Shield sleeves
- 1 Sapphire Pack
- 2 Event packs
- 2 boosters RDO
- 1 proxia vault pack

Top 8 prizes:
1st: 1 winner playmat + 1 finalist playmat + 1 invite card + 5 Sapphire packs + 6 event packs + 1 box RDO
2nd: 1 finalist playmat + 1 invite card + 6 Sapphire packs + 6 event packs + 12 boosters RDO
3rd – 4th: 1 finalist playmat + 1 invite card + 3 Sapphire packs + 4 event packs + 2 boosters PTM
5th – 8th: 1 finalist playmat + 1 invite card + 2 Sapphire packs + 2 event packs + 1 boosters PTM
 
Deck Construction Rules:
Min 60-card main deck
Max 12 card material deck
15 point sideboard (Main deck card = 1p, material deck card =3p)

(Players are required to submit their decklist on Omnidex before the event begins.)

-------------------------
Join the Outpost Ghent Discord to stay in touch with fellow players:
https://discord.com/invite/RUnm7x83zH
